convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for StepMA_NRTR indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh for position management logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_). Custom indicator buffers must be replicated in Python.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of the indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: Opposite signal closes position: if both SellPosOpen and SellPosClose are true and StepMA_NRTR buffer 0 (Up line) is non-empty, existing sell is closed. Similarly, if both BuyPosOpen and BuyPosClose are true and buffer 1 (Dn line) is non-empty, existing buy is closed.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input (0.1) is interpreted as lot size when MMMode=LOT, or as percentage/fraction for other modes.

custom_logic_notes: The StepMA_NRTR custom indicator has 4 buffers: Buffer 0=Up line, Buffer 1=Dn line, Buffer 2=Up signal (buy trigger), Buffer 3=Dn signal (sell trigger). Signal is read from bar index 'SignalBar' (default=1, previous bar). A Recount mechanism retries on CopyBuffer failure. Entry signals have a time window (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime = last bar time + one period) passed to position open functions, likely controlling order expiry. The closing logic has two layers: (1) primary signal-reversal close from signal buffers 2/3, and (2) additional close from trend buffers 0/1 when both open and close flags are enabled for that side. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags can independently disable entry or exit for each direction. BarsCalculated check ensures indicator is ready before processing. LoadHistory ensures bar data is available.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate StepMA_NRTR indicator logic in Python - it is a step-moving-average NRTR (No Repaint Trailing Range) indicator with volatility-based step calculation. The 4 buffers must be faithfully reproduced. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) implement order execution with signal time windows - this logic must be reimplemented. The MarginMode conditional sizing logic needs careful mapping. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous completed bar, avoiding repaint. No digit adjustment is performed on SL/TP values (1000 and 2000 are passed directly to trade functions), but the TradeAlgorithms.mqh may internally adjust - verify this during conversion.
